about: Weights of the letter classifier (scripts/letters/icdar_train.py) and the Greek prose language model (scripts/letters/greek_lm.py) that reader_api.py reads. `reader_api.py fetch` downloads them once and refuses a file whose SHA-256 differs. Every read is model output, not a reading.
runs_license: CC BY 4.0: trained on Hell-Char letter crops (CC BY 4.0, github.com/ipavlopoulos/diachronic-greek-letterforms at aeef8466) from timm's ConvNeXt ImageNet weights (Apache-2.0); no ICDAR 2023 image and no scroll data in training

lm.license: CC BY-SA 4.0: letter counts of 22 Perseus prose texts (PerseusDL/canonical-greekLit at 0189b9c8, CC BY-SA 4.0)
